method: Static interface analysis; audited small source fragments in a restricted probe; independent native adapters. Entire remote bundle is not imported or executed. Live-verified sources are labeled separately from offline adapter candidates included for phone-side testing.
scope: The full bundle was inventoried: 54 explicitly named metadata entries plus dynamically generated/config-dependent sources. Eight candidates received source-level endpoint checks in the prior pass. Four sources are now in the subscription: Qimiao and Duboku have complete live category/detail/search/HLS/media-segment evidence; Xingya and Ciyuancheng have independent adapters with offline end-to-end fixtures and 195-episode coverage, pending phone-side upstream validation.
